columns.name: gpuEnginesJson
columns.note: Actual rendering LUID only. collectTimestamp100ns is PDH FILETIME, previousCollectMs is the previous monotonic collect endpoint, rawQueryCode is the independent raw-query status. recording contains adapterLuid, instanceCount and invalidInstanceCount for other PIDs; engineTypes contains engineType, otherProcessesUtilFraction (sum other PIDs per physical engine, then maximum within type), instanceCount and invalidInstanceCount; topProcesses contains the busiest few other PIDs, limited by WindowsGpuEngineSampler.TopProcessCount, with processId, utilFraction (maximum physical engine) and current engines. Retained engines carry identity, formatted fraction/CStatus, current raw counters/status and actual FILETIME 100ns average endpoints; no exact monotonic average mapping or repeated previous raw counter values. SamplingFacts is computed from all matching instances before recording selection; it is independent of retained PID count.
